name: cards
description: A card game for practicing counting

scripts.prebuild: npm run sitemap && npm run tail
scripts.cy:ai:headed:local: cross-env CYPRESS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 cypress run --headed --browser chrome --spec cypress/e2e/ai-counter-watch.cy.js
scripts.e2e:counter:text:headed: cross-env CYPRESS_DISABLE_VIDEO=true start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:counter:text:headed
scripts.e2e:counter:headed: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 CYPRESS_DISABLE_VIDEO=true start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:counter:headed
scripts.e2e:counter:2000:headed: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 CYPRESS_DISABLE_VIDEO=true start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:counter:2000:headed
scripts.e2e:counter:2000:video: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:counter:2000:headed
scripts.e2e:ai:headed: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 CYPRESS_DISABLE_VIDEO=true start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:ai:headed
scripts.e2e:ai:headed:local: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 start-server-and-test dev http://127.0.0.1:5173 cy:ai:headed:local
scripts.e2e:counter:video: cross-env CYPRESS_ACTION_PAUSE_MS=200 CYPRESS_DEALER_STEP_MS=900 CYPRESS_CARD_DEAL_STAGGER_MS=150 start-server-and-test dev:e2e http://127.0.0.1:5199 cy:counter:2000:headed
scripts.e2e:counter:until-goal: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); let i=0; while(i<25){ i++; console.log('=== Attempt '+i+' toward $1075 ==='); const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','e2e:counter'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status===0){ console.log('GOAL REACHED'); process.exit(0);} } process.exit(1);"
scripts.e2e:counter:until-goal:headed: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); let i=0; while(i<25){ i++; console.log('=== Attempt '+i+' toward $1075 (headed) ==='); const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','e2e:counter:headed'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status===0){ console.log('GOAL REACHED'); process.exit(0);} } process.exit(1);"
scripts.e2e:counter:2000:until-goal: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); let i=0; while(i<40){ i++; console.log('=== Attempt '+i+' toward $2000 ==='); const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','e2e:counter:2000'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status===0){ console.log('GOAL REACHED $2000'); process.exit(0);} } process.exit(1);"
scripts.e2e:counter:2000:until-goal:headed: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); let i=0; while(i<40){ i++; console.log('=== Attempt '+i+' toward $2000 (headed) ==='); const r=spawnSync('npm',['run','e2e:counter:2000:headed'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status===0){ console.log('GOAL REACHED $2000'); process.exit(0);} } process.exit(1);"
